question: 同一增强前端、房间条件及掩码下，固定多通道 Wiener 滤波和 Souden MVDR 的噪声衰减与语音失真权衡如何随反射变化？
scope: 已查看的 G18 单房间配对对照。沿用 8 句、4 人、2 种录音、3 种请求 RT 和全部 504 个条件。
methods: 十个原有神经前端分别生成一个 MWF 输出。复用全部 10584 条历史信号，新增 5040 条。完整比较包含31个系统，各504例。
stft: 512-point periodic Hann, hop128, center reflect, exact-length ISTFT
covariance: Rs=sum(mXX^H)/T, Rn=sum((1-m)XX^H)/T. Half-power spectral masks come from the saved neural mono estimate and mixture minus estimate as in G18.
probe: First source in G18 selected_sources, OOFFICE point relative -80 target20 at all three RTs, plus clean at RT.35 target20. All ten neural estimates. Compare mask means with the corresponding saved MVDR diagnostics.
analysis: 同前端 MWF 减 MVDR 为主对照，同时保留直接输出。按 RT、噪声、角度、种子和说话人读回。WER 用总错误数除以参考词数。干净控制另报 RMS 增益和归一化平方误差。
